translation_notes: prefixes: DCTERMS->dcterms (the draft's rdf/dc/xsd declarations are unused and dropped)

the region is a single `self.graph.add(...)`: there is no run of adds on a shared subject in it -- `@graph self.graph` + one `+{ }` is the whole translation (the stratum label comes from the surrounding method)

`self` is a MepaToEDM stub from context_shim.py (graph, work_cho, recto_cho); the shim also exposes `graph = self.graph` so the harness, which compares module-level graphs, sees what the statement writes
optimization_notes: Nothing to compress: the region is one `self.graph.add(...)`. optimized.py is a byte copy of original.py and optimized.ldpy a byte copy of translated.ldpy (`@graph self.graph` + one `+{ }`). No exception to the symmetry rule.
header_optimization_notes: optimized_header.py: the rdflib.namespace import keeps only DCTERMS. The shim's `graph` stays although the region does not name it: it is the module-level graph the driver compares.
